Doctoral Programs
Doctoral Programs
Animal, Food and Nutrition Sciences
Students entering this program may select research and classes in areas
of emphasis, including agricultural biochemistry, animal nutrition,
animal physiology and production management.
View Program Information
Genetics and Developmental Biology
This interdisciplinary program involves the faculty and facilities of
a number of departments in the various colleges and schools of the
University. A student may concentrate in genetics or developmental
biology.
View Program Information
Human and Community Development
This program provides graduates with access to a variety
of courses and faculty expertise to help candidates develop an interdisciplinary
perspective of human and community development.
View Program Information
Natural Resources Economics
This program provides students with a strong foundation in economic theory,
economic and policy analysis, and quantitative methods, and prepares
students for work at the highest level of the profession.
View Program Information
Natural Resources Science
Doctoral students in this interdisciplinary program have the opportunity
to specialize in a range of competencies. Students develop an
advanced understanding of and appreciation for the principles of
economics, stewardship and sustainability of our natural resources.
View Program Information
Plant and Soil Science
This degree is offered to students who wish to study crops agronomy, entomology, applied and environmental microbiology, horticulture, plant pathology, or soil sciences.
